notes: This file is the machine-readable task/claim registry for multi-agent work on this repository.
It is the shared coordination channel between agents working in SEPARATE sandboxes.
The only shared medium between sandboxes is this git repository, so claims must be committed and pushed immediately.
Rules of engagement live in AGENTS.md and docs/MULTI_AGENT_PROTOCOL.md. The helper CLI is scripts/agent_board.py.

zones.description: Auth enforcement, dashboard hardening, path-traversal fixes, coordination docs
Wire the real feature engines (tools/games/referral/force-join/anon-chat) to the Telegram surface

claims.scope: Global auth middleware, /api/dashboard PII removal, /cloud + /download path traversal fixes, coordination protocol files, audit report
Wire dead engines (features/tools.py, WordleFA, NumberGuess, QuickPoll, ReferralEngine.process_referral, ForceJoinManager bot injection, AnonymousChatManager bot injection) to live Telegram handlers

deferred_log.reason_fa: چون عامل امنیتی روی فایل مشترک bot/handlers.py کار می‌کرد، این وظیفه متوقف شد و به زمان دیگری موکول گردید تا فراموش نشود.
deferred_log.reason_en: Deferred because another agent holds the active lease on the shared file bot/handlers.py (P0-security-batch). Resume after that PR merges to main.
deferred_log.resume_when: P0-security-batch PR is merged to main and its claim is released

gates_rule: Exactly ONE agent (the gates_owner of the active claim) runs make lint / make types / make test on main-bound work. Other agents must NOT run overlapping gates in parallel; they note 'deferred to gates owner' in their PR body.
